C0883.title: IBM Report Reveals Surge in Automated Credential Theft
C0883.summary: IBM 2025 X-Force Threat Intelligence Index reported that identity abuse and credential-related attacks appeared as an initial access point in about 30% of cases. Information stealers can quickly capture login data, shorten the time attackers need to enter enterprise environments, and combine with phishing emails, malicious attachments, and session credential abuse to amplify account takeover risk.
